Moving to an empty journey preserved the note and reset the day to Ideas for later.
Food plus Cuttack returned only Aloo Dum Dahibara.
Pathani Samanta found Samanta; alphabetical order combined with Bhubaneswar area in the URL.

limitations: Implementation self-review, not independent editorial review or accessibility certification.
Language and literary introductions await Founder and relevant speaker/specialist review. No community interviews or field visits completed.
SCSTRTI catalogue checked through indexed text; individual language booklets not read in full.
Tourism sources contain inconsistent claims; selected facts and clearly attributed legends only. No current opening, accommodation, access or performance guarantees.
Responsive checks used browser emulation; physical devices, screen readers and native PDF pagination remain unverified.
404.html built and inspected locally; unknown-route behaviour on the public host awaits deployment verification.
No public release, GitHub issue submission, paid service or cross-project adoption performed.
